# GlotChat

> All-in-one messenger for Windows that runs many WhatsApp, Telegram, Messenger, Instagram and Discord accounts in one window — each isolated, with its own notifications and proxy — and translates chats offline in 49 languages (plus voice notes and photos on WhatsApp and Telegram), with a check of every translation before it is sent.

GlotChat is a Windows desktop app — an all-in-one messenger for business. It opens the official websites of WhatsApp, Telegram, Facebook Messenger, Instagram and Discord for each account in its own isolated session, several accounts per app, and adds offline two-way translation of messages in every app (plus voice notes and text in photos on WhatsApp and Telegram). Before a reply is sent, it shows the translation translated back into the writer's language and checks that prices, numbers and links are unchanged. It is an independent product, not affiliated with WhatsApp, Meta, Telegram or Discord.

## Key facts

- Platform: Windows 10, Windows 11 (64-bit)
- Apps: WhatsApp, WhatsApp Business, Telegram, Facebook Messenger, Instagram Direct, Discord (several accounts of each; all apps in every plan)
- Accounts: tested with 27 accounts at the same time; each uses about 300–450 MB of memory
- Translation: 49 languages, offline on the user's PC; voice notes recognised in about 100 languages
- Free trial: 3 days, every feature, no payment — starts with one click in the app ("Start my free 3-day trial"), one trial per computer
- Download (Windows installer, version 1.2.5, 381 MB): https://download.glotchat.com/GlotChat-Setup-1.2.5.exe — install guide: https://www.glotchat.com/download/
- Prices (per year, paid in USDT TRC20 · BEP20 · ERC20): Starter 69 USDT (up to 5 accounts per app, 1 PC), Pro 129 USDT (up to 15 accounts per app, 1 PC), Business 249 USDT (unlimited accounts per app, 3 PCs)
- Contact / purchase: Telegram https://t.me/GlotChat
- Website languages: English, 简体中文, 繁體中文, العربية, Türkçe, Español, Português, Русский
